description: This Java source file implements the DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter class, which extends the DittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter and provides a stateful logging adapter for the Ditto framework. It handles MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries, correlation IDs, and integrates with Akka's DiagnosticLoggingAdapter to facilitate structured logging with context management.

classes.name: DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
classes.description: A stateful logging adapter for the Ditto framework that manages MDC entries and correlation IDs, facilitating structured logging and context propagation in an Akka-based environment.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter using an Akka DiagnosticLoggingAdapter and logger name.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID in the MDC entries, either from a CharSequence or from Ditto headers.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Explicitly sets the correlation ID in MDC entries.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID from the MDC context.

methods.name: setMdcEntry
methods.description: Sets a single MDC entry for the current logger.

methods.name: setMdcEntries
methods.description: Sets multiple MDC entries.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds an MDC entry to the current logger context.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds an MDC entry to the auto-discarding logger context.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry from the current logger context.

methods.name: discardMdcEntries
methods.description: Clears all MDC entries from the current logger context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the current logger.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if error logging is enabled.

methods.name: isWarningEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warning logging is enabled.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info logging is enabled.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug logging is enabled.

methods.name: notifyError
methods.description: Logs an error message or exception.

methods.name: notifyWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message.

methods.name: notifyInfo
methods.description: Logs an informational message.

methods.name: notifyDebug
methods.description: Logs a debug message.

methods.name: mdc
methods.description: Returns the current MDC as an immutable map.

methods.name: mdc
methods.description: Sets MDC entries from an immutable map.

methods.name: getMDC
methods.description: Returns MDC entries as a Java Map.

methods.name: setMDC
methods.description: Sets MDC entries from a Java Map.

methods.name: clearMDC
methods.description: Clears all MDC entries.
